## New article decision and verification

- Reader question: why do `agentsight top` overview counters not add native and captured model activity, and why can a native zero token total remain zero while capture shows 40? This is *whole-summary live top provenance*, distinct from local session discovery, native token reconciliation, background monitor CPU, and generic no-eBPF workflows.
- Primary v1.0.35 [implementation and regression tests](https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentsight/blob/c1574366122a90c451bca6a84713e28813ab95e2/collector/src/view/live_top.rs): `local_has_counters` is an OR over native view_events, llm_calls and total_tokens. If any native value is positive, top uses **all** native summary fields; only an all-zero native summary falls back to capture. Tests assert native 12/4/100 plus capture 5/2/40 -> 12/4/100; empty native 0/0/0 -> capture 5/2/40; mixed native 12/4/0 plus capture 5/2/40 -> 12/4/0. These are synthetic fixture counts, **not real measurements**. Per-row `/proc` and eBPF enrichment, and Network section replacement, are distinct from model overview totals.
- Chosen canonical: `/blog/why-agentsight-top-counters-do-not-add/`, with version/commit anchors, test matrix, reproduction instructions, limits, and links to existing token/discovery articles. No near-duplicate page.
